d: Driven to create unique home-grown food concepts that bring people together, the Independent Food Company is a UAE-based hospitality company with multiple concepts under its umbrella -SALT, Shalwa, Kumo, Parker’s, Somewhere and Public.

We’re looking for a Head of Marketing to lead the delivery of our marketing strategy across a growing, multi-site food and beverage group. You’ll sit at the centre of the function, connecting brand, digital, PR, franchise, partnerships and events, and making sure every campaign launches on time, on budget and on target. This is a hands-on leadership role with real ownership of budget, results and team, and a direct line to senior leadership.
q: 10+ years in marketing, with at least 4 years leading a multi-function team
Proven delivery of campaigns across digital, PR and partnerships, not just strategy
Commercial mindset: comfortable owning a budget and a sales target
Experience in a multi-site, multi-market FMCG, F&B, hospitality or retail group
A straight talker who can challenge the brief and still get it done
MBA or Lean Six Sigma is a big bonus
Complex matrix FMCG experience is a big plus
r: Oversight of digital, PR, franchise, and partnerships and collaborations
End-to-end delivery of every campaign across functions, through the campaign managers
The marketing budget and the sales targets it’s tied to, with your team accountable for both
Reporting on all campaigns: performance, wash-ups and what we do differently next time
The customer journey, alongside the Marketing Director, from first hello to loyalty
Cross-functional collaboration with regional teams, so what works in Dubai works elsewhere

The Marketing Director on strategy, the brand team, and regional and operations teams across the group. Day to day, you’ll work with the digital, PR, franchise, partnerships and events leads, plus our agency partners.
